mandate.standard: Russell 1000
mandate.test: All portfolio analytics compared to benchmark
mandate.effect: Benchmark return, volatility, momentum and yield comparisons

mandate.standard: Lower volatility than Russell 1000
mandate.test: Rolling 3-year and 5-year realized volatility
mandate.effect: Scenario must demonstrate favorable risk profile before certification

mandate.standard: Higher momentum than Russell 1000
mandate.test: Manifest momentum methodology versus benchmark
mandate.effect: Use empirical validation; do not optimize to a single period

mandate.standard: Higher dividend yield than Russell 1000
mandate.test: Portfolio yield versus benchmark yield
mandate.effect: Dividend growth preferred over static high yield

mandate.standard: 2.50% annual cash-flow objective
mandate.test: Portfolio yield / distributable cash flow ≥ objective
mandate.effect: Scenario income must be tested before certification

mandate.standard: 35% review ceiling; not a performance guarantee
mandate.test: Empirical / Monte Carlo drawdown test
mandate.effect: Failure requires redesign or explicit exception

mandate.standard: Long-term institutional horizon
mandate.test: Core holdings require durable long-horizon thesis
mandate.effect: Avoid short-term optimization of the core portfolio

mandate.standard: Daily liquidity required
mandate.test: All holdings must be publicly traded and operationally liquid
mandate.effect: Illiquid alternatives are not eligible

mandate.standard: 32–38 equities; controlled exception permitted
mandate.test: Monitor current equity count against preferred range
mandate.effect: Above-range count requires concentration/complexity review

mandate.standard: Maximum 41 equities without formal amendment
mandate.test: Certified equity count ≤ 41
mandate.effect: Exceeding ceiling blocks certification

mandate.standard: 47 positions in canonical Portfolio B
mandate.test: Position count must reconcile to MFPDF
mandate.effect: Scenario begins from the certified 47-position baseline

mandate.standard: Portfolio target must total 100%
mandate.test: SUM of certified targets = 100%
mandate.effect: No scenario may be certified if effective weights do not total 100%

mandate.standard: Each security may belong to only one production sleeve
mandate.test: No duplicate symbol across sleeve assignments
mandate.effect: Prevents double-counting of portfolio purpose

mandate.standard: Core role must be established before implementation exposure
mandate.test: Portfolio-role review precedes satellite allocation
mandate.effect: A security must have an explicit institutional function

mandate.standard: Core eligibility requires a five-year operating / evidence record unless excepted
mandate.test: Role Assignment documents evidence or exception
mandate.effect: Exception requires written committee rationale

mandate.standard: Dividend growth favored over headline yield
mandate.test: Compare payout durability, FCF and operating earnings growth
mandate.effect: Avoid yield-only selection

mandate.standard: No mid/small cap, international or alternatives in this sleeve
mandate.test: Candidate eligibility gate
mandate.effect: JEPI, JEPQ, PFF and approved Vanguard sector ETFs remain eligible

mandate.standard: Large cap above $50B for Zacks-driven elections unless excepted
mandate.test: Candidate market capitalization ($B)
mandate.effect: Sub-$50B candidates require documented exception

mandate.standard: Ranks #1/#2 favored; #3 neutral; #4/#5 require review / exception
mandate.test: Applied only when Manifest comparison is close
mandate.effect: Overlay does not replace MIAR, MICS, empirical or role-fit evidence

mandate.standard: Merrill-rated securities preferred; No Rating requires documented exception
mandate.test: Candidate eligibility / exception record
mandate.effect: Mega-cap Zacks #1/#2 may remain eligible under documented exception

mandate.standard: Lower MAX(1%, 75% of target); upper MIN(4%, 125% of target)
mandate.test: Compare actual and scenario weights with certified bands
mandate.effect: Band breach triggers review, not automatic trade

mandate.standard: Not authorized
mandate.test: No output may authorize automatic execution
mandate.effect: Committee review precedes implementation

mandate.standard: Engineering scenarios cannot overwrite the certified portfolio
mandate.test: Certified Allocation remains unchanged
mandate.effect: Only a newly certified MFPDF version becomes operational

mandate.standard: Material allocation changes require empirical and/or Monte Carlo review
mandate.test: Turnover, additions/removals, sleeve shift or risk change
mandate.effect: Optimization output is evidence, not authority

mandate.standard: All 47 actual weights must be loaded
mandate.test: Count of nonblank Certified Allocation column I
mandate.effect: Blocks implementation funding and live band review

mandate.standard: Every active holding must have an assigned conviction tier
mandate.test: Count of non-Unassigned effective convictions
mandate.effect: Blocks final certification of a changed portfolio

mandate.standard: Benchmark, income and risk analytics must be current
mandate.test: Current empirical / risk evidence package
mandate.effect: Required before substantive redesign certification

mandate.standard: Engineering review, research sufficiency, allocation/risk and committee approval
mandate.test: All PEW-007 approvals completed
mandate.effect: Scenario remains non-operational until MFPDF version is issued
